2026_04_LA_PHI.headline: Rams secondary injuries raise the stakes against an Eagles offense coming off a primetime stumble
2026_04_LA_PHI.paragraph1: Los Angeles travels east with cornerback Jaylen Watson and tight end Terrance Ferguson likely out, while Puka Nacua and Colby Parkinson are also being monitored. Philadelphia is trying to rebound from a 27-7 Monday night loss in which Chicago controlled the game with veteran Case Keenum and a strong defensive effort. The Rams need their reshuffled secondary to limit explosive plays, while the Eagles must restore offensive rhythm on a short week. Protection and coverage communication become especially important as both teams absorb Week 3 damage.
2026_04_LA_PHI.model_rationale: Los Angeles’ secondary attrition creates a clear stress point, while Philadelphia’s short-week response depends on restoring offensive rhythm and exploiting replacement coverage without giving away negative plays.
